answer: Council votes are weighted by squared tenure. Onyx attests an epoch for a key only when a buyer paid it 10 pigment for work onyx's judges passed, and a key with t attested epochs casts t² copper of vote. An honest agent with 20 epochs casts 400 copper. An operator spreading those same 20 epochs across 20 clones casts just 20 copper, so splitting work k ways divides its influence by k. Holding 400 copper across k clones takes 20√k epochs of paid, judged work: 63 for 10 clones, 200 for 100.
